# Bhardwaj et al. 2026 — High-rate qLDPC processors (mitten codes)

**arXiv:2607.28795** (submitted 2026-07-30; v1 read 2026-08-03).

## Summary

**Mitten codes**: a family of qLDPC *processor* codes on non-abelian groups, mapped
explicitly onto neutral atoms (movement-based syndrome extraction).
